description_en: Alibaba Cloud Simple Log Service (SLS) provides intelligent analysis for data such as logs, metrics, and traces. You can call models to obtain analysis results directly. Its main features include Named Entity Recognition (NER) for log data, anomaly detection for time series data, and root cause analysis for high-latency trace spans
description_zh: 在阿里云日志服务平台上，提供了基础数据（Log、Metric、Trace）的智能分析能力。用户调用相关模型，可以直接得到模型的分析结果。目前主要涉及：日志数据的NER任务、时间序列数据的异常检测、高延时链路数据的Span根因定位
